idea-plugin.name: ARP - Accessibility Report
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Added "View HTML Report" feature to export the accessibility report as a self-contained HTML file and open it in the browser
  • Updated "View Source XML" feature to export the raw UI Automator XML dump and open it in the editor

1.1.0

  • Added "Show Missing Accessibility" feature to highlight elements with missing accessibility attributes
  • Added hover highlight on tree nodes
